changes.title: A full-screen start screen
items: The start screen fills the window with big, easy-to-read text over the dimmed forest
"New in" this version lists each change with its own heading and bullets, dated, with the two versions before it underneath
"Coming up" lists the work in progress, straight from what the builders have open, so it's always current
On a phone, drag to scroll the text; a tap still starts

changes.title: Species fight
items: Every animal now fights its own way: rams back off and ram, stags charge in pairs, elk swing wide, bears swipe hard and short, badgers dig in, beavers block with their tails, lynxes pounce, foxes and martens go round to your back, snakes strike from hiding, moths flock to light, hedgehogs and woodlice roll up, snails leave slowing slime, glow-worms flash to slow you, and stoats, otters, squirrels and dormice dart and weave

Each new move shows clearly: glistening slime, a burst of glow-worm light, a ring of thrown-up earth round a dug-in badger, a beaver's raised tail and the glint of a blocked shot, spikes whirling round a rolling hedgehog
Try each new move in the arena: ?arena=ram, pair, wide, swipe, dig, block, flank, packflank, pounce, strike, moth, roll, woodlouse, slime, flash, weave, otter, squirrel, dart

changes.title: Momentum and spacing
items: Charging boars have weight: they lower their head, build up speed, thunder on past you, then skid round in a wide arc before coming again
Creatures in a fight speed up, slow down and turn smoothly, without jerking or flickering left and right; a momentum knob joins fight scale and speed in the debug panel (, and .)
Wild creatures give up the chase soon after you leave their area (about 10 m past its edge) and head back home
Animals don't bunch up any more: walking, following you, marching or fighting, each keeps some room round it, more for big ones (a bear keeps much more space than a dormouse)

changes.title: Freeze
items: Esc (or Start on a gamepad, or the ❚❚ button by the volume) pauses everything, music too, as a still picture for screenshots; a panel shows the version, seed, game time, where you are, the area and the camera, with a link to copy; while paused, . steps one frame and Shift+. ten; Esc again carries on

changes.title: Dream stacked
items: A legend's dream bubble stacks the creature it wants above its face, and stays on screen when you stand close

changes.title: Nightmare face
items: A legend's nightmare shows one face that grows from slightly sad, through sadder and upset, to angry as it gets more restless
